caption: A steaming bowl of shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender noodles, a soft-boiled egg, shredded cabbage, and chopped green onions. Served in a white ceramic bowl with a black mark, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Light wood grain table surface with visible texture and natural wood coloration.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles, egg, and toppings.
White ceramic ramen bowl with subtle black mark near rim, smooth surface, circular shape, slightly glossy finish.
